pages.title: Spacetime Catalyst
pages.text: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime, tied tightly enough that it keeps itself in shape. Hyperdimensional processes use it as a template without consuming it. Space around it bends inward, and objects set beside it roll gently toward the centre.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Tesseract Assembler, I wrapped spacetime alloy around a Micro Singularity, a Tesseract Core and a Higgs Catalyst, with Exotic Matter and Chronon Gas. The curvature knotted itself and held.
Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Eternity Catalyst, Theoretical Notes II.
